ball_by_ball.commentary_text: Shreyanka Patil to Nonoha Yasumoto, no run. Good length ball defended.
Shreyanka Patil to Ayumi Fujikawa, 1 run. Pushed into gaps.
Flat trajectory, on the fuller side of good length, at the off stump, from around the wicket. Warded off towards cover.
Quicker, flatter, on a length, in the channel outside off. Yasumoto defends it in an awkward manner.
Lobbed up on the fuller side of good length, from over the wicket, at the imaginary fourth peg. Yasumoto prods forward to defend it.

OUT! CAUGHT! Charani gets her fourth wicket. On a good length, at the stumps. Quinn made room by moving half a step to the leg side and then, swung for the heavens. Alas, she got more height than distance. Shafali, at mid-on, pouched it without any fuss. Japan slip to 56/9.

OUT! CAUGHT! Charani gets her fourth wicket. On a good length, at the stumps. Quinn made room by moving half a step to the leg side and then, swung for the heavens. Alas, she got more height than distance. Shafali, at mid-on, pouched it without any fuss. Japan slip to 56/9.
Round-arm-ish, drifts in at the off pole, on a good length and then, spins away to avoid Quinn's attempted big heave.

Soft dismissal. Charani gets another one to her name. Drifted in at the leg stick on a good length. Nishimura shaped up to play it on the leg side, but the ball spun sharply to square her up. Eventually, the batter got a leading edge and it ballooned towards Fulmali, who had some catching practice at short midwicket.

Soft dismissal. Charani gets another one to her name. Drifted in at the leg stick on a good length. Nishimura shaped up to play it on the leg side, but the ball spun sharply to square her up. Eventually, the batter got a leading edge and it ballooned towards Fulmali, who had some catching practice at short midwicket.
Full, at the off stump, from over the wicket. Dragged to long-on for a single.
Bowls a flatter and quicker one at the stumps, off a good length, from around the wicket. Mistimed heave towards midwicket for a single.
Good length, spinning in at the pads. Nudged behind square leg for a single.
A tad fuller, outside off. Fujikawa crouches to heave it towards deep midwicket for a single.
Good length, off peg or thereabouts. Watchfully pushed towards cover. No run.

MIX UP... RUN OUT! Chandel has to go. Outside off on a good length. Nishimura's reached for it, swept it towards Nandani stationed in front of square leg and then, slipped on the pitch in trying to run through to the other end. Chandel was a bit slow to respond and could not make it to the batting end either. Nandani could thrown at either ends and there would have been a wicket. She chose Ghosh's corner and the keeper made no errors in dislodging the bails.

MIX UP... RUN OUT! Chandel has to go. Outside off on a good length. Nishimura's reached for it, swept it towards Nandani stationed in front of square leg and then, slipped on the pitch in trying to run through to the other end. Chandel was a bit slow to respond and could not make it to the batting end either. Nandani could thrown at either ends and there would have been a wicket. She chose Ghosh's corner and the keeper made no errors in dislodging the bails.
On a length, outside off, from over the wicket. Nishimura attempts a sweep, only to inside edge it onto her body.
Fires a slightly quicker one, on a slightly fuller length, at the off peg. Chandel defends in a watchful manner.
BEAUTY! Drifted in from around the wicket, at the off stick, on a length full enough to draw Chandel forward. The ball spun to go past her outside edge.

RUN OUT! Good length, outside off. Goto crouched to try and heave it leg side. Alas, she only connected with the inside edge of the bat and the ball trickled away towards the fine leg region. Smriti Mandhana fielded the ball there and returned a flat and accurate throw to Richa Ghosh, who was quick to break the stumps. Alas, Goto could not be back home in time for the second run despite the big dive. One run and a wicket off this ball.

RUN OUT! Good length, outside off. Goto crouched to try and heave it leg side. Alas, she only connected with the inside edge of the bat and the ball trickled away towards the fine leg region. Smriti Mandhana fielded the ball there and returned a flat and accurate throw to Richa Ghosh, who was quick to break the stumps. Alas, Goto could not be back home in time for the second run despite the big dive. One run and a wicket off this ball.
Shafali Verma to Shimako Kato, OUT! Wicket falls at 16.3.

MISCUED... CAUGHT! Flat trajectory, on a length, outside off. Kato squared up and tried to flat-bat it towards the leg side. Alas, the ball rather went towards mid-off, where Harmanpreet dived forward to grab it. Japan are 51/5.
Fires a quicker one at the pegs, it ends up being a low full toss and is squeezed away towards deep square leg for two. 50 up for Japan!
Good length, outside off, from over the wicket. Nishimura gets down on a knee and then, sweeps it towards deep midwicket for a single.
Spins back in, short and around middle. Kato tucks it down towards mid-wicket.
Darts a full one outside off. Kato leans forward to knock it to mid-off. No run.
Fires a quick one down the leg side off a good length. Kato does not lay bat on ball. Wide ball.
Good length, spinning in at the pegs. Kato wanted to swish it away to the leg side, but ended up copping it on her body.
Fired full at the poles. Defended in a resolute manner.
Lobs it up on a drivable length outside off. Kato goes for an expansive shot and gets beaten.
Fuller side of good length, flat trajectory, spinning into the off peg, from over the wicket. Kato still plays it off the backfoot and presents a stubborn defence.
Darts a full one at the poles. Nishimura defends in a stubborn manner.
Good length, spins to evade the half-hearted flick and finishes down the leg side. Wide ball.
Darts a fuller one at the pegs. Nishimura still hangs back and plunges her bat down to block it.
Similar length, at the poles. Steady defence from the crease.
On a length, outside off. Nishimura gets back and dabs it towards point.
Shafali Verma to Ayaka Stafford, OUT! Wicket falls at 14.2.

OUT! Soft dismissal. Flighted on a good length, not far from the off stump. Stafford stepped out and tried to give it a whack. Alas, she could not clear Kamalini at mid-off. Easy grab for her. Japan slip to 46/4.
Good length delivery from over the wicket, goes on with the arm after pitching and finishes at the fourth peg. Warded off to cover in a watchful manner.
A tad quicker, at the off pole, full in length. Knocked to long-on for a run.
Lobbed up outside off, on a length. Stafford skips out of her crease to get to it and then, puts it away to mid-off. No run.
PUT AWAY! FOUR! Deepti tried to dart in a yorker at the leg stick. Stafford got inside the line, crouched and then, swept it away to the long leg boundary.
Lobbed up on a good length, in the channel outside off. Stafford sweeps it along the carpet and gets a couple before Patil returns the ball from the deep.
Fires it fuller, off stump or thereabouts. Squeezed to mid-off.
Good length, at the off and middle, from over the wicket. Stafford prods forward to bunt it to mid-on.
Fuller, again spinning into the pads. Stafford attempts a flick, but ends up closing the bat face early. The ball goes towards backward point off the leading edge. One run.
Good length, spins in towards the pads. Kato dinks it towards square leg and picks a run before Fulmali fields the ball.
Darts a fuller one at the poles. Kato plunges her bat down to defend it.
Good length, spinning in at the middle and leg. Swished away to the leg side sweeper for a single.
Fuller, not far from the off stick. Kato gets forward to ward it off to cover.
Quicker, outside off, on a length. Left alone. Wide ball.
Flat through the air, outside off, on a length. The batter jabs away from the body, and the ball runs towards deep third off the outside edge to fetch her a double.

OUT! CAUGHT! How long could you have kept Deepti Sharma from picking a wicket? Floated up on a good length, outside off. Oda got on her knee before unleashing a slog sweep. Alas, she picked Shreyanka Patil, stationed at deep midwicket, with precision. No mistakes in the completion of the catch.

OUT! CAUGHT! How long could you have kept Deepti Sharma from picking a wicket? Floated up on a good length, outside off. Oda got on her knee before unleashing a slog sweep. Alas, she picked Shreyanka Patil, stationed at deep midwicket, with precision. No mistakes in the completion of the catch.
Similar length and line. Swept nicely along the carpet to deep square leg for a single.
Switches to around the wicket and hurls it at the imaginary fourth pole, on a full length. Stafford defends off the front foot in a dutiful manner.
Full toss at the pegs. Flicked straight to short midwicket. No run.
Lobbed up on a drivable length, not far from the off stump. Stafford gets forward and knocks it back to the bowler.
Full, at the stumps, from over the wicket. Tapped back to the bowler.
Flat trajectory, outside off, on a good length. Oda wafts and misses.
Good length, off stump or thereabouts. Chopped to backward point.
Fires a quicker one in at the middle stick, on a full length. Squeezed back to the bowler.
Tossed up at the off stick, on a full length. Knocked to mid-on for a quick single.
Flatter, quicker, spinning in towards the off peg. Dabbed towards backward point, off the backfoot.
Lobs it up on a good length, outside off, from over the wicket. Oda crouches before heaving it to mid-on for a single.
Pushes across, full and around middle. Oda gets down and sweeps it to square leg, who fumbles and concedes a single.
Spins back in, full and around middle. Oda nudges it down to mid-wicket.
A yorker, around off. Stafford uses her feet and jams it down to backward point. Sneaks a tight single. The throw comes a bit late to the keeper.
Slows it up, full and around middle. Stafford walks across and gets down. Sweeps it to mid-wicket.
Pushes across, full and around off. Stafford takes a step ahead and drives it down to mid off.
Over the wicket. Tosses it up, full and around off. Oda drills it down to long on for one.
MAIDEN! Same line - full and just outside off. Stafford looks to work it away into the leg side but closes the bat face early. Gets beaten on the outside edge.

On the fuller side and outside off. Stafford lunges a bit and tries to nudge it but misses as the ball drifts away. Ghosh, the keeper, dislodges the bails but Stafford's back foot is inside her crease.
BEAUTY! Spins away, full and outside off. Stafford gets forward and tries to flick it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Spins away, short and around off. Stafford goes back and dabs it down into the deck.
Slows it up, full and around off. Stafford drives it down to cover.
Round the wicket. Short and around off, knocked it down to cover point.
Sliding in, full and around middle, flicked it down to the left of deep mid-wicket and sneaked two runs. Excellent running!
Flighted, full and around middle. Oda knocked it down to the right of the bowler, where Patil dived and stopped it.
Lands it fuller and around off. Oda nudges it down to mid-wicket.
Pushes across, full and around off. Stafford knocks it down to the right of the diving bowler for a quick single.
Much fuller and outside off, jammed it down to mid off.
Round the wicket. Tosses it up, full and around off. Stafford clips it down to mid-wicket.
Pushes across, full and around off. Oda lunges and stabs it down to cover point.
Slows it up, full and outside off. Oda pushes it down to backward point.
NO HAT TRICK FOR CHARANI! An arm ball, full and around off, defended it down to cover.

OUT!! TWO IN TWO FOR SHREE CHARANI, AND SHE WILL BE ON A HAT-TRICK ON THE NEXT DELIVERY! Short and just outside off, luring the batter. Yanagida gets caught in two minds about whether to play this off her front foot or back foot. She chooses the latter option but gets late. Tries to defend it but gets a faint outside edge as the ball turns away. The keeper, Ghosh, snaffles this sharp catch behind the wickets. Yanagida departs for a golden duck!

OUT!! TWO IN TWO FOR SHREE CHARANI, AND SHE WILL BE ON A HAT-TRICK ON THE NEXT DELIVERY! Short and just outside off, luring the batter. Yanagida gets caught in two minds about whether to play this off her front foot or back foot. She chooses the latter option but gets late. Tries to defend it but gets a faint outside edge as the ball turns away. The keeper, Ghosh, snaffles this sharp catch behind the wickets. Yanagida departs for a golden duck!

OUT!! TAKEN! THERE COMES THE FIRST BREAKTHROUGH! Spins away, full and around off. Iwasaki gets down and tries to take on the bowler to up the ante. However, she plays against the spin and pays the price. Goes for a slog-sweep but ends up mistiming it to the right of long on, where Shafali moves across a bit and snaffles it. Iwasaki departs for 10.

OUT!! TAKEN! THERE COMES THE FIRST BREAKTHROUGH! Spins away, full and around off. Iwasaki gets down and tries to take on the bowler to up the ante. However, she plays against the spin and pays the price. Goes for a slog-sweep but ends up mistiming it to the right of long on, where Shafali moves across a bit and snaffles it. Iwasaki departs for 10.
Round the wicket. Short and around off, defended it down to backward point.
Almost a yorker, around middle, whipped it to deep backward square leg for one.
Round the wicket. Short and around middle, spinning back in. Iwasaki defends it a bit uppishly but the ball lands short to the left of the bowler.
Pushes across, short and around off. Iwasaki knocks it down to mid-wicket.
Sliding in, full and around middle, flicked it down to the right of mid-wicket for one.
WIDE!! Drifting down the leg side and on the shorter side. Stafford opens her stance and looks to pull it but misses.
Too full and around off, pushed it down back to the bowler.
Over the wicket. Spins back in, short and just outside off. Stafford covers her off stump and shoulders her arms.
FOUR!! CONNECTS WELL THIS TIME! Lands it fuller and around off. Iwasaki crouches and gets underneath the ball. Blazes it over the mid on fielder for a boundary to end the over.
Slows it up, full and outside off. Iwasaki gets down and tries to slog-sweep it but misses due to the turn and extra bounce.
Short and outside off. Stafford goes back and opens her stance. Pulls it down to deep mid-wicket for one.

FIRST FOUR OF THE MATCH! A BIT STREAKY! Spins away, full and around off. Stafford gets forward and tries to flick it, but gets a leading edge. The ball races away past the keeper to her right for a boundary.
A full toss, around off, knocked it down to mid on off her front foot.
Round the wicket. Short and around off, dabbed it down to backward point.

Hurls it on the fuller side and around off. Iwasaki crouches and tries to lift it downtown. Doesn't get the timing right but gets enough to clear the mid off fielder. Two runs are taken before the long on fielder can mop it up to her left.

Back of a length and around off, with the pace taken off. Iwasaki tries to nudge it with soft hands but gets deceived by the change of pace. Misses, and the ball hits her back thigh pad before it rolls down beside the strip on the off side. Both batters sneak a leg bye. However, Richa Ghosh picks up the ball and tries to score a direct hit at the bowling end but misses. Out of an overthrow there, both batters take another run! Iwasaki has to put in a dive to save herself.
On the fuller side and outside off, squeezed away to deep third for one.
Drifting in, full and around middle, tucked it down to the right of mid-wicket for a quick single.
A bit fuller and around off, knocked it down back to the bowler, where Nandani leapt, but the ball went over her and rolled down to mid off.
BEATEN! Over the wicket. Swinging away, full and outside off. Iwasaki tries to cut it with an angled bat but misses as her feet don't go anywhere.
Sliding in, full and around middle, flicked it down to mid-wicket.

COULD HAVE BEEN CHOPPED ON THERE! Back of a length and just outside off. Stafford tries to cut it but gets an inside edge. Gets lucky as the ball goes past the off stump and rolls down to the left of the keeper. Two runs are taken before the short fine leg fielder can mop it up.
On a length and around off, chopped it down to backward point.
Dragged back length and around off, dabbed it down to the right of the bowler.
Angling in, full and around middle. Stafford gets behind the line and blocks it.
Over the wicket. Back of a length and in the channel outside off, with the pace taken off. Stafford tries to cut it but gets deceived by the change of pace.
Keeps it fuller and the line is around off. Iwasaki knocks it down to mid off.
Brings it into the stumps and bowls it fuller. Iwasaki crouches and whips it but picks out the mid-wicket fielder.
WIDE BALL! Short of a good length and wide outside off. Iwasaki tries to reach out but misses.
Full, but way outside the tramline on the off side. Haruna walks across a bit but lets it go to the keeper as the ball further swings away.
A bit fuller and around off, swatted it down to the left of the mid on fielder.
Angling in, full and around middle, flicked it down to the right of mid on for a quick single.
Over the wicket. Hurls it on the fuller side and outside off, shaping away. Stafford shoulders her arms.
Hits the deck hard and bowls it outside off. Haruna mistimes her swat to mid off.
Short of a good length and just outside off. Haruna tries to cut it but misses due to the extra bounce.
Pitches it up, full and around off. Iwasaki drives it down to mid off.
Short of a good length and outside off, punched it down to the right of backward point for a brace to get off the mark.
Back of a length and in the channel outside off. Iwasaki gets up on her toes and looks to slash but connects with thin air only.
Over the wicket. On a length and outside off. Haruna tries to cut it but misses.

Pushes across, full and around off. Oda lunges and stabs it down to cover point.
Slows it up, full and outside off. Oda pushes it down to backward point.
NO HAT TRICK FOR CHARANI! An arm ball, full and around off, defended it down to cover.

OUT!! TWO IN TWO FOR SHREE CHARANI, AND SHE WILL BE ON A HAT-TRICK ON THE NEXT DELIVERY! Short and just outside off, luring the batter. Yanagida gets caught in two minds about whether to play this off her front foot or back foot. She chooses the latter option but gets late. Tries to defend it but gets a faint outside edge as the ball turns away. The keeper, Ghosh, snaffles this sharp catch behind the wickets. Yanagida departs for a golden duck!

OUT!! TAKEN! THERE COMES THE FIRST BREAKTHROUGH! Spins away, full and around off. Iwasaki gets down and tries to take on the bowler to up the ante. However, she plays against the spin and pays the price. Goes for a slog-sweep but ends up mistiming it to the right of long on, where Shafali moves across a bit and snaffles it. Iwasaki departs for 10.

Round the wicket. Short and around off, defended it down to backward point.
Almost a yorker, around middle, whipped it to deep backward square leg for one.
Round the wicket. Short and around middle, spinning back in. Iwasaki defends it a bit uppishly but the ball lands short to the left of the bowler.
Pushes across, short and around off. Iwasaki knocks it down to mid-wicket.
Sliding in, full and around middle, flicked it down to the right of mid-wicket for one.
WIDE!! Drifting down the leg side and on the shorter side. Stafford opens her stance and looks to pull it but misses.
Too full and around off, pushed it down back to the bowler.
Over the wicket. Spins back in, short and just outside off. Stafford covers her off stump and shoulders her arms.
FOUR!! CONNECTS WELL THIS TIME! Lands it fuller and around off. Iwasaki crouches and gets underneath the ball. Blazes it over the mid on fielder for a boundary to end the over.
Slows it up, full and outside off. Iwasaki gets down and tries to slog-sweep it but misses due to the turn and extra bounce.
Short and outside off. Stafford goes back and opens her stance. Pulls it down to deep mid-wicket for one.

FIRST FOUR OF THE MATCH! A BIT STREAKY! Spins away, full and around off. Stafford gets forward and tries to flick it, but gets a leading edge. The ball races away past the keeper to her right for a boundary.
A full toss, around off, knocked it down to mid on off her front foot.
Round the wicket. Short and around off, dabbed it down to backward point.

Hurls it on the fuller side and around off. Iwasaki crouches and tries to lift it downtown. Doesn't get the timing right but gets enough to clear the mid off fielder. Two runs are taken before the long on fielder can mop it up to her left.

Back of a length and around off, with the pace taken off. Iwasaki tries to nudge it with soft hands but gets deceived by the change of pace. Misses, and the ball hits her back thigh pad before it rolls down beside the strip on the off side. Both batters sneak a leg bye. However, Richa Ghosh picks up the ball and tries to score a direct hit at the bowling end but misses. Out of an overthrow there, both batters take another run! Iwasaki has to put in a dive to save herself.
On the fuller side and outside off, squeezed away to deep third for one.
Drifting in, full and around middle, tucked it down to the right of mid-wicket for a quick single.
A bit fuller and around off, knocked it down back to the bowler, where Nandani leapt, but the ball went over her and rolled down to mid off.
BEATEN! Over the wicket. Swinging away, full and outside off. Iwasaki tries to cut it with an angled bat but misses as her feet don't go anywhere.
Sliding in, full and around middle, flicked it down to mid-wicket.

COULD HAVE BEEN CHOPPED ON THERE! Back of a length and just outside off. Stafford tries to cut it but gets an inside edge. Gets lucky as the ball goes past the off stump and rolls down to the left of the keeper. Two runs are taken before the short fine leg fielder can mop it up.
On a length and around off, chopped it down to backward point.
Dragged back length and around off, dabbed it down to the right of the bowler.
Angling in, full and around middle. Stafford gets behind the line and blocks it.
Over the wicket. Back of a length and in the channel outside off, with the pace taken off. Stafford tries to cut it but gets deceived by the change of pace.
Keeps it fuller and the line is around off. Iwasaki knocks it down to mid off.
Brings it into the stumps and bowls it fuller. Iwasaki crouches and whips it but picks out the mid-wicket fielder.
WIDE BALL! Short of a good length and wide outside off. Iwasaki tries to reach out but misses.
Full, but way outside the tramline on the off side. Haruna walks across a bit but lets it go to the keeper as the ball further swings away.
A bit fuller and around off, swatted it down to the left of the mid on fielder.
Angling in, full and around middle, flicked it down to the right of mid on for a quick single.
Over the wicket. Hurls it on the fuller side and outside off, shaping away. Stafford shoulders her arms.
Hits the deck hard and bowls it outside off. Haruna mistimes her swat to mid off.
Short of a good length and just outside off. Haruna tries to cut it but misses due to the extra bounce.
Pitches it up, full and around off. Iwasaki drives it down to mid off.
Short of a good length and outside off, punched it down to the right of backward point for a brace to get off the mark.
Back of a length and in the channel outside off. Iwasaki gets up on her toes and looks to slash but connects with thin air only.
Over the wicket. On a length and outside off. Haruna tries to cut it but misses.
